bot.name: IPODevta
bot.short_description: Only the IPOs that pass your board and GMP % filters. Daily at 11:00 AM.
bot.description:
IPODevta sends you only the IPOs that pass your filters.

Set two things: Mainboard / SME / Both, and the minimum GMP %. Tap a preset or Type % to enter any number.

Every market day at 11:00 AM: one clean message per IPO that passes. IPOs open but none pass? One line telling you to stay out. No IPOs open? No message.

No filters wanted? Join the channel for every open IPO at 10:00 AM.

Information only - not investment advice. Read the RHP.

help.none:
• IPOs open but none pass: one 🚫 message. Stay out that day.
• No IPOs open: no message.
